# mcrl org

[Command reference](README.md)

Show the organization and its settings.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`org get`](#mcrl-org-get) | Show the organization of the API key |
| [`org ip-restriction`](#mcrl-org-ip-restriction) | Manage IP address restrictions |

## mcrl org get

Show the organization of the API key.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl org get

Show the organization of the API key.

API: GET /api/v0/org
API key permission: Read

Examples:
  mcrl org get
  mcrl org get --jq .name
```

## mcrl org ip-restriction

Manage IP address restrictions.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`org ip-restriction get`](#mcrl-org-ip-restriction-get) | Show the allowed IP ranges |
| [`org ip-restriction set`](#mcrl-org-ip-restriction-set) | Replace the allowed IP ranges |

## mcrl org ip-restriction get

Show the allowed IP ranges.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl org ip-restriction get --target web|api [flags]

Show the IP ranges allowed to access the web console ("web") or the API ("api").

API: GET /api/v0/settings/ip-restriction/{web,api}
API key permission: Read

Examples:
  mcrl org ip-restriction get --target api
  mcrl org ip-restriction get --target web --jq '.cidrs[]'

Flags:
      --target string   web or api (required)
```

## mcrl org ip-restriction set

Replace the allowed IP ranges.

```text
Usage:
  mcrl org ip-restriction set --target web|api (--cidr <cidr>... | --clear) [flags]

Replace the IP ranges allowed to access the web console or the API.
--clear removes the restriction.

Be careful: a list that excludes where you are locks you (and mcrl) out.
The command always asks for confirmation unless --yes.

API: POST /api/v0/settings/ip-restriction/{web,api}
API key permission: Read, Write

Examples:
  mcrl org ip-restriction set --target api --cidr 203.0.113.0/24 --cidr 198.51.100.10/32
  mcrl org ip-restriction set --target web --clear

Flags:
      --cidr stringArray   allowed IP range in CIDR notation (repeatable)
      --clear              remove the restriction
      --no-refetch         print the API response ({"success": true}) instead of fetching the updated resource
      --target string      web or api (required)
```
